title: Simple Survial
body:
In this ModPack,\
you will find the beauty of Vanilla Minecraft,\
while adding some QOL Mods to improve the normally boring gameplay\
you may find yourself in.

Explore, build, just be adventurous!\
Nothing much here, but also not _nothing_.\
The perfect balance between heavy Mods and light Mods.\
It comes with some performance Mods to make the experience better,\
mostly on low-end devices, so theres no excuse to not download this ModPack!

You'll surely feel the stunning views you will get,\
all thanks to [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons), [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/mod/tectonic) and [Geophilic](https://modrinth.com/mod/geophilic)\
and you will never want to miss this ModPack ever again.

Features:

1. Stunning Terrain
2. Lots Of QOL Mods
3. Performance Mods
4. Shader Support

And a little secret, there are **GUNS**.\
Just don't tell your friend 'bout that.

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
